dashboard.keys.label: Keyboard shortcuts
dashboard.rules.title: Active rules
dashboard.overlay.title: Overlay
dashboard.overlay.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it by hand.
dashboard.overlay.hint: Add this address in OBS as a Browser source. Use localhost, not an IP address: YouTube's player refuses videos on a page opened by an IP address.
status.chat.no_username: No TikTok username yet. Enter it on the Account page to read the chat.
dashboard.tiktok.title: TikTok chat
dashboard.tiktok.hint: The program reads the live chat of this account and follows a change at once, without a restart. Leave it empty to stop reading chat.
error.no_api_key: No YouTube API key is set. Enter one on the Account page to accept video requests.
dashboard.account.title: Account
dashboard.account.hint: The channel and the credentials this program uses. Credentials can only be changed from the computer the program runs on.
dashboard.account.locked: You are connected from another computer, so you can see what is set but not change it. Open the dashboard on the computer that runs the program to change it.
dashboard.account.youtube.title: YouTube API key
dashboard.account.youtube.set: A key is set (it ends in {ending}).
dashboard.account.youtube.unset: No key is set. Video requests are refused until you enter one.
dashboard.account.youtube.source.saved: Saved from this dashboard. It replaces YOUTUBE_API_KEY, if that is set.
dashboard.account.youtube.source.environ: From the YOUTUBE_API_KEY environment variable or the .env file.
dashboard.account.youtube.label: New API key
dashboard.account.youtube.hint: The key is tried with one YouTube request (1 quota unit) before it is saved, takes effect at once, and is never shown again.
dashboard.account.youtube.saved_quota: Key saved. Today's YouTube quota is used up, so video lookups work again after it resets.
dashboard.account.error.key_bad_format: That is not shaped like a YouTube API key (no spaces or line breaks, at most 200 characters).
dashboard.account.error.key_rejected: YouTube refused this key. Check that it is right and that the YouTube Data API v3 is enabled for it.
dashboard.account.error.cannot_check: Could not reach YouTube to check the key. Nothing was changed; try again.
dashboard.account.error.not_saved: The key could not be written to disk, so nothing was changed.
dashboard.account.error.loopback_only: Credentials can only be changed from the computer the program runs on.
dashboard.account.token.title: Dashboard token
dashboard.account.token.unset: No token is set. The dashboard only accepts connections from this computer.
dashboard.account.token.hint: The token is set with DASHBOARD_TOKEN in .env. Making a new one from here will come later.
status.chat.paused: Chat disconnected. Choose Connect chat in the account menu to read it again.
